title: Organizer uses Early Completion
description: On an active tournament, open Stop Tournament. Early Completion finishes remaining matches as NP when enough matches are played.

steps.title: Stop tournament
steps.body: The red X opens a destructive dialog. Abandon cancels the event; Early Completion can complete it early when the percentage rule is met.

steps.title: Early Completion
steps.body: Enter your password to Abandon. Early Completion uses the club min-played % (you can override it in this dialog). Remaining matches become NP.
steps.resultNote: Stop Tournament dialog with Early Completion.

steps.title: Early Completion control
steps.body: Use Early Completion only when you intend to finish the event. This capture does not submit it.
